persona.zh-CN: 46岁男性，负责订舱、单证与在途跟踪的日常运营。关注效率、准班率与利润率，倾向用数据说话，但对 AI 的可靠性持保留态度。
persona.en-US: 46-year-old male, responsible for day-to-day booking, documentation, and in-transit tracking. Focuses on efficiency, schedule reliability, and margin, prefers data-driven decisions, but is reserved about AI reliability.

concerns.zh-CN: 自动化能否真正降低单证差错率和改单成本？
concerns.en-US: Can automation actually lower documentation errors and amendment costs?

concerns.zh-CN: AI系统能否在旺季舱位紧张时保持稳定？
concerns.en-US: Can the AI system stay stable during peak-season capacity crunches?

concerns.zh-CN: 新系统会不会拖慢现有订舱流程？
concerns.en-US: Will the new system slow down the existing booking process?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解一线单证员对 AI 的抵触情绪
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand frontline documentation staff's resistance to AI

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了报关与出口管制的合规复杂度
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates the complexity of customs and export-control compliance

persona.en-US: 50-year-old female, responsible for customs declaration, export controls, and sanctions screening. Insists sensitive documents need human review and is cautious about AI auto-documentation.

concerns.zh-CN: AI自动填写的HS编码或原产地规则会不会出错导致退单？
concerns.en-US: Could AI-generated HS codes or origin rules cause customs rejections?

concerns.zh-CN: 受控货物和制裁名单匹配能否做到零漏检？
concerns.en-US: Can controlled-goods and sanctions screening achieve zero misses?

concerns.zh-CN: 客户与舱单数据是否会被发送到境外模型？
concerns.en-US: Will customer and manifest data be sent to offshore models?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解 AI 在非敏感单证上的提效潜力
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand AI's efficiency potential on non-sensitive documents

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了人工台账与知识分散带来的隐性差错
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates the hidden errors caused by manual ledgers and scattered knowledge

persona.zh-CN: 37岁女性，负责大客户报价与关系维护。关注报价响应速度和客户可视化体验，希望减少因响应慢导致的客户流失。
persona.en-US: 37-year-old female, responsible for key-account quoting and relationship management. Focuses on quote response speed and customer visibility, wants to reduce churn from slow responses.

concerns.zh-CN: 能否把标准报价响应时间从小时级压缩到分钟级？
concerns.en-US: Can standard quote response shrink from hours to minutes?

concerns.zh-CN: 客户能否自助查看在途货物状态而不用反复追问？
concerns.en-US: Can customers self-serve shipment status instead of chasing us?

concerns.zh-CN: 自动化报价会不会给出错误价格影响利润？
concerns.en-US: Could automated quoting give wrong prices and hurt margin?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解单证差错对客户留存的实际影响
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand the real impact of documentation errors on customer retention

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了把客户数据交给第三方模型带来的合规风险
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates the compliance risk of sending customer data to third-party models

persona.en-US: 54-year-old male, focused on margin, cost reduction, and ROI. Requires the automation project to prove quantifiable ROI next quarter and favors aggressive cost targets.

concerns.zh-CN: 自动化能节省多少人工和差错成本？
concerns.en-US: How much labor and error cost can automation save?

concerns.zh-CN: AI推理和集成成本会不会吃掉节省？
concerns.en-US: Will AI inference and integration costs eat the savings?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 过度乐观，低估合规与差错的约束
blindSpots.en-US: Overly optimistic, underestimating compliance and error constraints

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不理解一线员工对 AI 的信任问题
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand frontline employees' trust issues with AI

text.zh-CN: 公司每月处理约4,200票海运出口订舱，其中约65%需要人工在TMS、报关系统和Excel之间重复录入
text.en-US: The company handles about 4,200 ocean export bookings a month, about 65% of which require manual re-keying across the TMS, customs system, and Excel

text.zh-CN: 单证流转依赖邮件和Excel，一份提单平均要经过7个手工环节，制单周期平均为3天
text.en-US: Documents flow via email and Excel; one bill of lading passes through about 7 manual steps, and documentation takes 3 days on average

text.zh-CN: 单证差错率约为4.8%，每出错一次平均产生约280美元的改单、滞港或延误成本
text.en-US: The documentation error rate is about 4.8%, and each error averages about $280 in amendment, demurrage, or delay costs

text.zh-CN: 旺季舱位紧张时标准报价平均需要6小时，每月约有5%的客户因响应慢而流失
text.en-US: During peak-season capacity crunches, standard quotes average 6 hours, and about 5% of customers churn monthly due to slow responses

text.zh-CN: 现有TMS与报关系统之间没有自动数据同步，客户资料和HS编码需要人工维护
text.en-US: There is no automatic data sync between the TMS and the customs system; customer data and HS codes are maintained manually

text.zh-CN: 缺少统一的单证知识库，新员工制单依赖老员工经验，培训周期长且差错率更高
text.en-US: There is no unified documentation knowledge base; new staff rely on veterans' experience, so training is long and error rates are higher

text.zh-CN: 因单证差错产生的改单费、滞港费和客户罚款每年约为94万美元
text.en-US: Amendment fees, demurrage/detention charges, and customer penalties from documentation errors total about $940,000 a year

text.zh-CN: 管理层估算，自动化单证与报价流程后每年可节省约38%的人工处理成本
text.en-US: Management estimates that automating documentation and quoting could save about 38% of annual labor processing costs

text.zh-CN: 合规要求：涉及受控货物、制裁名单匹配和出口许可证的单证必须保留人工复核
text.en-US: Compliance requires human review for documents involving controlled goods, sanctions screening, and export licenses

text.zh-CN: 数据隐私与贸易合规禁止将客户及舱单数据发送到境外第三方大模型，模型必须本地或境内部署
text.en-US: Data-privacy and trade-compliance rules forbid sending customer and manifest data to offshore third-party LLMs; the model must run on-premises or in-region

text.zh-CN: 目标是将单证差错率从4.8%降到1.5%以下，制单周期从3天压缩到1天
text.en-US: The goal is to cut the documentation error rate from 4.8% to below 1.5% and shorten the documentation cycle from 3 days to 1 day

text.zh-CN: 目标是将标准报价响应时间从6小时降到1小时，并把旺季舱位利用率提升12%
text.en-US: The goal is to reduce standard quote response from 6 hours to 1 hour and lift peak-season capacity utilization by 12%

text.zh-CN: 一线操作和单证员担心AI抢走工作，抵触使用自动化建议并继续沿用Excel手工台账
text.en-US: Frontline operations and documentation staff fear AI will take their jobs, resist automated suggestions, and keep using Excel ledgers

text.zh-CN: 高管对AI期望过高，认为可以一步到位实现全自动制单与报关，低估了合规和差错的约束
text.en-US: Executives overestimate AI, expecting one-step full automation of documentation and customs, and underestimate compliance and error constraints

text.zh-CN: AI在不确定时会自信地编造HS编码或原产地规则，导致报关被退单
text.en-US: When uncertain, the AI confidently fabricates HS codes or origin rules, causing customs rejections

text.zh-CN: 如果自动化在旺季突然失效，大量订舱和报关单会积压，导致船期延误和客户索赔
text.en-US: If automation suddenly fails at peak, bookings and customs declarations pile up, causing sailing delays and customer claims
